correctness.rationale: Every finite nonempty 2-regular simple graph is a disjoint cycle union. The verified Brown–Hoshino theorem shows all C_n with n>=7 are rank-three equivalent. Congruence of EF equivalence under disjoint sum and a three-component cap give 1023 representative configurations. The exact back-and-forth recursion computes their quantifier-rank-three sentence types; checker.py exhaustively verifies 12 classes and the equivalent six-sentence signature. game_crosscheck.py implements separate three-round EF minimax for 144 ordered representative pairs and five positive pairs. Finite enumeration is not extended without the proved reduction.

The closest full text, Brown–Hoshino 2007, determines only comparisons between two connected cycles or two connected paths, not disjoint cycle unions. Standard EF/disjoint-sum theory provides reductions but not the exact twelve-class invariant. Residual unindexed-literature risk is acknowledged.

value.rationale: Supplies the complete precise first disconnected degree-two rank-three EF classification, an exact natural invariant of twelve, and six explicit rank<=3 formulas deciding equivalence. Extends a literature-motivated connected-cycle study of rank games to arbitrary two-factors, with a genuinely nontrivial component collapse rather than a small isolated numeric improvement. Scope restricted to rank three; no broader theorem claimed.
